description: Lists moving companies Haulest holds dated, attributed reviews for in a city, state, province, or country (US, Canada, UK), with the average rating, the number of reviews on record, the newest review date, the USDOT number where there is one, and the profile URL. Ratings are means of real reviews on record; Haulest does not rank companies by payment. Use it when someone wants movers in a place; follow with the profile tool for one company.

limit.description: How many companies to return, up to 10 (larger values return 10). Default 6.

market.description: Country to prefer when a place name exists in more than one: us, ca, or uk.

minReviews.description: Only companies with at least this many dated reviews on record.

place.description: City, state or province, country, or a ZIP or postcode, e.g. "Denver, CO", "Ontario", "Manchester", "Canada", "80202", "M5V".

sort.description: recommended (default), newest review, highest rating, or lowest rating.

name: find_movers
title: Find movers near a place
